page.overview:
Who is Kitana?

Kitana, sometimes referred to as Princess Kitana and once as Kitana Kahn, is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. The Princess of Edenia, daughter of Sindel, and former Kahnum of Outworld, she is one of Emperor Shao Kahn’s adopted daughters and serves as the primary love interest of series protagonist Liu Kang.

Kitana made her debut in Mortal Kombat II and has remained a staple of the franchise ever since, appearing as a playable character in nearly every installment.

A new version of Kitana appears in Mortal Kombat 1 as a playable fighter and a supporting character in the game’s Story Mode. A counterpart from the previous timeline also makes an appearance as a supporting character.

Princess Kitana is over 10,000 years old but is considered young by Edenian standards, possessing the appearance of a woman in her prime. Over the centuries, she rose to great prominence—first as the loyal stepdaughter of Shao Kahn, and later as his sworn enemy, breaking free from his control and liberating her home realm of Edenia. She eventually led an army into Outworld to prevent any chance of Shao Kahn’s return to power.
